chart.name: Tasks finished

chart.name: Top hosts by memory %
chart.programText:

B = data('memory.used', filter=filter('plugin', 'memory')).mean(by=['host']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B/(A+B)*D*100).top(count=5).publish(label='C')
D = graphite('gauge.{master_elected,slave_registered}', node0=0, node1=1).count(by=['host']).below(1, clamp=True).publish(label='D', enable=False)

B = data('gauge.master_tasks_running', filter=filter('plugin', 'mesos')).sum().timeshift('1w').publish(label='B', enable=False)

chart.name: Hosts CPU %
chart.programText:
A = data('system.cpu.time', filter=filter('state', 'idle') and filter('plugin', 'aggregation') and filter('plugin_instance', 'cpu-average'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).scale(100).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cpu.idle', filter=filter('plugin', 'aggregation') and filter('plugin_instance', 'cpu-average'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
U = union(A, B).publish(label="U")
C = ((100-U)*I).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (C).min().publish(label='D')
E = (C).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='E')
F = (C).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='F')
G = (C).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='G')
H = (C).max().publish(label='H')
I = graphite('gauge.{master_elected,slave_registered}', node0=0, node1=1).count(by=['host']).below(1, clamp=True).publish(label='I')

chart.name: Hosts disk I/O
chart.programText:
A = data('disk_ops.write', filter=filter('plugin', 'disk'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('disk_ops.read', filter=filter('plugin', 'disk'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = graphite('gauge.{master_elected,slave_registered}', node0=0, node1=1).count(by=['host']).below(1, clamp=True).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (A*C).sum().publish(label='D')
E = (B*C).sum().publish(label='E')

chart.name: Top hosts by CPU %
chart.programText:
D = graphite('gauge.{master_elected,slave_registered}', node0=0, node1=1).count(by=['host']).below(1, clamp=True).publish(label='D', enable=False)
A = data('cpu.idle', filter=filter('plugin', 'aggregation') and filter('plugin_instance', 'cpu-average'), rollup='rate').mean(by=['host']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cpu.*', filter=filter('plugin', 'aggregation') and filter('plugin_instance', 'cpu-average'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((B-A)*D/B*100).top(count=5).publish(label='C')
E = data('system.cpu.time', filter=filter('plugin', 'aggregation') and filter('plugin_instance', 'cpu-average') and filter('state', 'idle')).mean(by=['host']).publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = data('system.cpu.time', filter=filter('plugin', 'aggregation') and filter('plugin_instance', 'cpu-average')).sum(by=['host']).publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = ((F-E)*D/F*100).publish(label='G')
